command_template: python3 tools/debian_native_container_probe.py CLIENT VERIFIED_DEB DEB_SHA256 VERIFIED_SKILL_ZIP SKILL_SHA256 --fixture-mode response-body-limit --container-memory-mib 128
fixture: Route-free DNS/HTTP; approved /plain, 70000-byte fixed-length /large, 70000-byte /chunked-large, approved recovery /plain.
limitations: Container cgroup memory.peak and pids.peak include package setup, helpers and server; they are high-water marks for this finite run, not server-only RSS, FD, or general upper bounds.
128 MiB memory limit and 64 PID limit are Docker controls; zero OOM events means these particular native-client calls completed within them.
Clients ran on Ubuntu host while server ran in disposable Debian 12 amd64 container. No Cursor, automatic triggering, arbitrary concurrency, or traffic through other tools is covered.
No official candidate or owner acceptance; package remains experimental and unsigned.
